normalization: Project Gutenberg texts stripped at the START/END markers, CRLF to LF, otherwise unaltered; Internet Archive OCR text layers as fetched, uncorrected (text/<slug>.ocr.txt) — the scan under original/<identifier>/ is the witness; Wikisource texts as rendered from the proofread transcription, page headings marked '=== title ==='.
scope: Books and first printings to 1923. The Futurist journals (Poesia, Lacerba) are on the Internet Archive issue by issue and are not seated here: QUEUED as a separate run. Blast 2 (1915) is access-restricted on the Internet Archive (HTTP 401) and is not seated. Kruchenykh and Khlebnikov's Победа над солнцем (1913) not located in a public-domain witness; QUEUED.

why_seated: The movement that put the word on the page as an object. Parole in libertà and zaum are the two ends of the operation the archive calls a constructed language: Marinetti's typography makes the sentence a field; Kruchenykh's 'дыр бул щыл' makes a word that answers to nothing before it.
ruling: Lee Sharks, 2026-10-15: "we need more seatings of avant garde literature. dada. farce. oulipo. futurist. - whatevers in the public domain. originals is good on classics, impoverished on modern. and i want the italian troubadors. and pound, more pound. need the cantos." — "and the concrete poets" — "also need jarry, schlovsky, etc" — "it gets an ea-corpora deposit and a spine and a card on tll, bulk seatings per ea-corpora deposit is fine".
